description: List NFTs owned by an XRPL classic account using the native account_nfts method. Use this instead of list_account_objects when you need NFT-specific fields such as NFTokenID, Issuer, NFTokenTaxon, URI, and nft_serial. This is read-only and does not modify the ledger. Use ledger_hash or ledger_index to pin the ledger, and pass marker from a previous response to continue pagination. Use this for NFTs owned by an account. Use n9t2_xrpl_list_nft_offers for marketplace buy/sell offers on a specific NFTokenID.

account.description: XRPL classic account address whose owned NFTs should be listed.
account.title: Account

ledger_hash.description: Optional ledger hash used to pin the NFT inventory lookup.
ledger_hash.title: Ledger Hash

ledger_index.description: Optional validated ledger index or selector.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

limit.description: Optional maximum number of owned NFT records to return.
limit.title: Limit

marker.description: Pagination marker returned by a previous response.
marker.title: Marker

name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_nfts
